name: Read File
description: Read a file from a configured filesystem root or an authorised DLFS path. The mode controls decoding: auto (default), text, bytes, or json. Binary auto reads return a WebDAV URL when one is available, otherwise inline base64.
creator: Covia

root.description: Configured root name; omit for a canonical DLFS path

path.description: Path relative to root, dlfs/<drive>/<path>, or <ownerDID>/dlfs/<drive>/<path>

content.description: File content for modes auto/text/bytes (text or base64)

mime.description: Best-guess MIME type from extension and content sniffing

url.description: WebDAV URL when auto mode returns a binary reference
